laurent_ring_definition.formal_isomorphism: ev_tau: Z[X, X^-1] -> R_tau, X |-> tau

finite_linear_independence.statement: For any finite distinct integer grades K_1, ..., K_r and algebraic coefficients a_1, ..., a_r in Q_bar, sum_{j=1}^r a_j tau^{K_j} = 0 implies a_1 = ... = a_r = 0

grade_zero_algebraicity_selection.statement: A finite Laurent expression F(X) = sum_{K=-M}^N a_K X^K in Q_bar[X, X^-1] evaluates to an algebraic native value F(tau) in Q_bar if and only if a_K = 0 for all K != 0, so that F(tau) = a_0
grade_zero_algebraicity_selection.uniqueness: F(tau) = G(tau) in Q_bar[tau, tau^-1] iff F = G identically

unit_group.algebraic_meaning: The elements tau^K are the canonical non-trivial units of the TC Laurent ring

graded_prime_classification.definition: p tau^K for rational prime p in P and K in Z
graded_prime_classification.algebraic_status: Prime element of R_tau associate to rational prime p
graded_prime_classification.proof_basis: R_tau / (p) \cong F_p[X, X^-1] is an integral domain because F_p is a field; units preserve primality
graded_prime_classification.associate_relation: p tau^K ~ p tau^J via unit tau^{J-K} in U(R_tau)
graded_prime_classification.geometric_status: Distinct spatial points in R for K != J: same prime referent under distinct grade units

grade_lines_and_transfer.pairwise_intersection: L_K \cap L_J = \emptyset for K != J; including zero: L_K^0 \cap L_J^0 = {0}

algebraic_no_transfer_theorem.statement: For x = m tau^K in L_K and y = n tau^J in L_J with m, n in Q_bar^x and K != J, there exists no algebraic scalar alpha in Q_bar^x such that alpha * x = y
algebraic_no_transfer_theorem.proof_contradiction: alpha * (m tau^K) = n tau^J implies tau^{J-K} = alpha * m / n in Q_bar, contradicting Lindemann (1882)

grade_lines_and_transfer.transcendental_transfer_map: Exact coordinate bijection exists: x |-> tau^{J-K} x from L_K to L_J via transcendental grade unit multiplier

unit_metric_and_staircase.prime_gap_invariance: (p_{r+1} tau^K - p_r tau^K) / tau^K = p_{r+1} - p_r
unit_metric_and_staircase.staircase_station_invariance: pi_K(p tau^K) = pi(p) and pi_K(tau^K u) = pi(u)

multiplication_and_grade_conservation.multiplication_law: For x in R_K and y in R_J, x * y in R_{K+J}, so deg(x * y) = deg(x) + deg(y)
multiplication_and_grade_conservation.opposite_grade_cancellation: (p tau^K)(q tau^-K) = p * q in R_0 = Z; tau^K * tau^-K = 1
multiplication_and_grade_conservation.overclaim_correction: Transcendence DOES cancel multiplicatively under bilateral pairing; the correct invariant is that distinct grades cannot cancel linearly over algebraic coefficients

total_grade_zero_monomial_rule.statement: A monomial product M = a prod_{j=1}^r (p_j tau^{K_j})^{e_j} with a in Q_bar^x is algebraic if and only if total grade G = sum_{j=1}^r e_j K_j = 0

rational_grades.mechanism: Common denominator reduction to N: u = tau^{1/N} is transcendental; distinct integer powers of u are linearly independent over Q_bar

irrational_algebraic_grades.rigorous_bound: dim_Q S_tau <= 1 via Gelfond-Schneider line collinearity; general linear independence across irrational algebraic grades is NOT proved

grid_family.label: ARITHMETIC_TC_GRID_FAMILY
grid_family.zero_set: Z_K^grid(s) = 0 iff zeta(s) = 0 (stationary zero set: zeros DO NOT move)
grid_family.composite_conservation_note: A product prod_p (1 - (p tau^K)^-s)^-1 would produce tau^{-K Omega(n) s} instead of tau^{-Ks}; global grade unit tau^K must be factored globally

pullback_family.label: AUXILIARY_ANALYTIC_PULLBACK_FAMILY
pullback_family.zero_set: Zeros transported to tau^K rho (moving zeros)
pullback_family.prime_stations: Staircase jumps at p^{tau^-K} (dilation u |-> tau^-K u)

repository_conflation_audit.resolution: Z_K^grid(s) = tau^{-Ks} zeta(s) is the canonical arithmetic TC zeta object; Z_K^pull(s) = zeta(tau^-K s) is reclassified as auxiliary analytic coordinate dilation

zero_character_interpretation.reinterpretation: Evaluated normalized grade-unit twist factor of Z_K^grid on spectral parameter rho; does not require physical transport of zeros on the arithmetic prime line

candidate_sources_audited: Euler product ratios: Z_K^grid(s) / Z_J^grid(s) = tau^{-(K-J)s} vanishes at zeros identically (0/0)
Logarithmic derivative: introduces log(tau) which is transcendental, violating Q_bar coefficient firewall
Riemann converter: single-frequency covariance is a conformal change of variables, not a mixed-grade sum
Bilateral pairing: (p tau^K)(p tau^-K) = p^2 cancels grade trivially; |eta_rho(K)| * |eta_rho(K)|^-1 = tau^{K delta} * tau^{-K delta} = 1 cancels spectral exponent identically
cross_grade_constraint_audit.coefficient_field_firewall: Coefficients in any legal linear relation must be proved to lie in Q_bar; non-algebraic quantities (log p, gamma, rho, log tau) cannot enter
cross_grade_constraint_audit.bilateral_sum_algebraicity: tau^{K delta} + tau^{-K delta} is transcendental for any rational delta != 0, but no zeta identity equates this sum to an algebraic native value
